He was renowned for his bravery and was the commander of the left wing of the Persian army during the Battle of Nineveh. After a failed Byzantine siege, Behrouz led a successful counterattack and killed the Byzantine Emperor Heraclius' brother Theodosius. However, he was later killed in the Battle of Jalula during the same war.

Behrouz was also a Persian hero in the Shia tradition, who was allegedly the standard-bearer of Imam Ali during the Battle of Jamal in 657 AD.
